content:
I'd try: Hameln+Lotan+Ramona+[Caecus] to start off with.  

Swap Caecus for Thais or Horla if you want to try those variants and different realm combos.   Caecus will help a bit because when you rouse him, every card you play will heal you. He also gives you access to Aqueor tentacles, so you can choose to shield each turn, which will also improve surviving. 

Lotan will be focused on doing damage with a lot of strikes.    Rouse Caecus then Lotan then whoever.

I recently got into traphase and must say it's quite fun. However, it's very hard to pick up - there are many units, wheels, posses that I don't even own.
This pulled me towards draft instead, since technically both players should have more equal standings. 

I tried to improve by reading all the cards.
However, I find the game interface to be very time consuming - just to read a unit's abilities, I have to perform at least 10 clicks and go through 3 pages. 
1. deselect old unit
2. select unit I want to view
3. click details to new awaker page 
4. click 4 skills
5. click exalt
6. click new awaker reviews page and uses (could be more or less clicks. truly depends how many I see)
7. click out to all units page 
8. repeat 
Assuming I only see 1 review, that is still 10 clicks and 3 pages to understand 1 card. That is terrifyingly slow. 

Apart from feeling overwhelmed with all the new cards I have to learn, I am hampered by how tedious it is to navigate a card's abilities. 

What do you guys do to make it faster? Is there a better UI, or a website that compiles the cards in a better overview? 

Also any tips for traphase draft in general? I literally just started

Hello there ~

There are about 5 types of banners and 3 kinds of currency ( pure cores, etheral cores, luminous cores ) :

- The top-most should be the newcommer banner. You will be asked to select a few awakeners to pull for. Usually a great option to get you started.
> Uses etheral cores first (time-limited) then luminous cores.

Next are the usual limited banners : use etheral cores first (time-limited) then luminous cores.
- Awakener banner, could be single awakener or three of them.
> They are usually quite useful but make sure to borrow them in an event to check how they fit in your linups
- WoD banner, single or triple
> Usually not mandatory but could be worth invesging if you got spare cores

All the way down are the regular banners : use pure cores
- Awakener pulls from a realm you choose ( chaos, caro, æquor, ultra )
> Regular doesn't mean useless. Some of this are effective even on endgame content
- Regular WoDs pulls with a selector
Aside from all that, did you find Cheri's handbook ? (just type /new if you didn't )
